title: WorkerConfig
description: Android only (DESIGN 3.3, D20): the EncryptedSharedPreferences file the app rewrites with a synchronous commit() on every settings change and every app start; read by COMP-ANDROID-WORKER. Excluded from backup and wiped first by delete-all. The worker treats it as missing or stale when the file is absent, format_version differs from the worker's, or app_version differs from the installed app version; then it makes NO network request and writes an inbox entry with status pending_app. Holds the bearer token: never log any value.

format_version.description: Version of this file format. A worker built for another format_version treats the file as stale.

written_at.description: Epoch milliseconds (UTC) of the last rewrite.

token.description: Opaque bearer token (secret). Never logged, never in kv.

install_salt.description: Per-install HMAC salt for idempotency keys (secret to the device).

install_watermark.description: Epoch milliseconds (UTC). Screenshots captured before it are never processed automatically.
